The denial is the stated ground of the unit type that the verse establishes directly, and it sits in the denial-behind-a-comma shape. The two samekh marks the row cites stand immediately in front of the two messenger-formula onsets at 11:16 and 11:17, neither formula named, and 11:17 also turns from third-person speech about the exiles to 2mp address — an unweighed, mark-and-formula-corroborated interior candidate. Decision: confidence moves to medium.

P02-008 (Ezek.11.1-11.13, medium) — CHALLENGE medium: three close-class devices inside the span are unnamed (utterance signature 11:8; 2mp recognition refrain 11:10 and 11:12) while the row's own sentence denies its close is a recognition or utterance refrain; 11:5 carries the address verb with the Spirit falling — the seam-grade device inside a vision — and the 11:5 alternative is declined on the oracle test instead; and the pe entered against 11:1 divides 11:1 from 11:2, so it is interior to the span, yet is cited as onset corroboration while the identical pe against 11:6 is correctly called interior. Boundary kept (participant inclusio: Jaazaniah and Pelatiah named at 11:1, Pelatiah dies at 11:13).

P02-011 (Ezek.12.1-12.7, medium) — CHALLENGE medium: filed as a commanded symbolic action with no sign-act signal and no mention of the sign-noun at 12:6 (1 of 4 such verses book-wide) or the in-their-sight refrain (7 occurrences on the 5 verses 12:3-12:7). The second sign-noun verse, 12:11, sits on the far side of the row's own cut and the acts are re-enacted at 12:12, so the genre device straddles the 12:7/12:8 seam and that continuity is owed a mandatory disclosure. Cut stands.
